400270104.text: ...Your faces say that, perhaps, you haven't turned up anything?

400270105.text: We investigated all over the mountain, actually. But we didn't see anyone that looked like you, or hear of anyone else meeting you...

400270106.text: This is not unexpected. I haven't made much progress, either. He appears to know that we are looking for him, and has opted to lie low for the time being.

400270107.text: (Or maybe he has always operated discreetly.)

400270108.text: Still, there is one thing I found. I discovered footprints on some parts of the mountain, and although they were a little covered by the snow, I could tell they had been left by someone of a similar size to myself.

400270109.text: The footprints were quite numerous, so I believe my next step will be to rule out each of the adventurers active on Dragonspine one by one...

400270110.text: We can help with that. We have plenty of contact with the adventurers.

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the source of the voice

400270201.text: Hey, did you see that? Did those rocks shake just now?

400270203.text: What are you guys doing here!?

400270204.text: I'd assume it was some sort of bad luck.

400270205.text: I have to agree. We've been wandering this area for days...

400270206.text: We ran into Pallad earlier. You know, the, uh... kind of a reckless sort of guy? You know the one? Anyway, he said he was unlucky, so I gave him some adventuring survival tips...

400270207.text: After that, he disappeared to rejoin the training camp.

400270208.text: Wait, wait, wait... are you saying that after all this time, you still haven't made it back to the base camp?

400270209.text: Haha... Well, as you can see...

400270210.text: It was nothing, really. We just hit a few landslides and snowdrifts, and took a few downhill tumbles, you know the deal.

400270211.text: They sound like unforgettable life events to me.

400270212.text: Anyway... You're correct, we haven't made it to the base camp yet. We have had extraordinarily poor luck over the last few days, almost as if a sinister force has been trying to thwart our every move.

400270251.text: Fortunately, I made advance arrangements for Gerald to remain in a safe location and conduct some basic physical training exercises.

400270213.text: I'm sorry... I'm the one to blame for all this. I've always had bad luck and it always rubs off on everyone around me...

400270214.text: Sorry to create so much extra trouble for everyone... *sigh*.

400270215.text: I don't know what to say... Maybe this is the awesome power of fate — the scary kind, I mean.

400270219.text: I am not scared to be around you.

400270220.text: Yep, we're just used to it now! Besides, it's not like we have the most amazing luck ourselves...

400270221.text: Really? I think you guys have way better luck than I do!

400270222.text: Well... what can we do about that? Oh, Paimon knows, how about Paimon shares some of her luck with you!

400270223.text: You're welcome to a bit of mine, too! Although, if the last few days are anything to go by, it seems in pretty short supply at the moment...

400270226.text: Aww... Thanks. With a little luck from everyone combined, we'll make it down this mountain for sure!

400270228.text: Let me flip a Treasure Hoarder Insignia to test it out... Alright! It's tails, the opposite of what I guessed!

400270229.text: So you can predict your fortune this way? But why are you so happy that you got it wrong?

400270230.text: It has two sides, so there is a 50-50 chance of me getting it correct.

400270231.text: Luck all comes down to probability, too. So as long as I use up all the bad luck, everything else will go smoothly!

400270232.text: Guessing wrong when I flip an insignia is one way to use up some of the bad luck. So the probability of having some good luck in the near future just got a little higher.

400270234.text: Hey, he's making no sense at all... why aren't you calling him out!?

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the source of the voice

400270301.text: Here we are. Make yourselves comfortable.

400270302.text: Oh... I forgot, I don't have that many chairs. Please wait a moment.

400270305.text: He is painting a chair... Wait, alchemy can turn paintings into objects!? How is this possible?

400270306.text: My paintings are like blueprints — alchemy simply enables me to omit the manufacturing part of the process. It's an elementary-level technique.

400270307.text: With enough research and experimentation, this same technique can even be used to create living beings.

400270308.text: Whoa... Well, since you can magically produce chairs, can I have one with a backrest?

400270310.text: No problem. How many of you want backrests?

400270313.text: ...I'll also take one with a backrest, if you please.

400270314.text: Can Paimon have a chair that comes with a juicer?

400270315.text: A whole chair is way too big for you, surely?

400270316.text: Still beats squeezing onto a stool with you! Hmph!

400270317.text: Cool, we have chairs now! Haha, this is so comfortable! Makes me want to stay the night here!

400270318.text: You're very welcome to stay overnight, if you wish.

400270319.text: There's still some time before dinner. Get some rest, everyone. I'll tend the stove.

400270320.text: Hey now, we can't be letting you do all the work! I can help, please, put me to work!

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait until nighttime (18:00 – 06:00 the next day)

400270601.text: #Alright. Let's start with the head! Now, {NICKNAME}, in your mind's eye, what is written on Paimon's face?

400270605.text: Huh? Is that how Paimon really looks to you? Huh...

400270606.text: Okay forget it, we can come back to that. Let's move onto the body! C'mon! Paint what you see when you look at Paimon!

400271502.text: It's almost ready now. Traveler, please light the campfire and gather everyone for dinner.

400270801.text: I wonder if there's anything I can do to help out... ?

400270803.text: Oh, you mean Gerald? I heard that Eula developed a whole training program for him.

400270804.text: He might be new, but I bet he'll improve pretty quickly with a mentor like that.

400270402.text: Food's ready, everyone! Come on, let's eat!

400270403.text: I made a few dishes based on some popular Mondstadt recipes. This is no Good Hunter, but there should be enough to go around.

400270405.text: Wow, smells great! Don't mind if I do!

400270406.text: Wait, don't steal all the fried vegetables. Leave some for me! ...Hey!

400270407.text: Ah... Paimon's full. What a great meal!

400270408.text: Albedo, you're too modest. These dishes are as good as anything you'd find in a top restaurant. Are all alchemists so good at cooking?

400270409.text: You may be onto something there.

400270410.text: Right? Paimon thinks so, too! It's his lab manner that gives it away — the kind of guy who holds a potion bottle as steady as a rock isn't the kind of guy who's gonna be slapdash with his salt and pepper.

400270411.text: Actually, that makes a lot of sense!

400270412.text: I'm so sleepy after all that food... zzz...

400270413.text: Did Bennett fall asleep sitting up? He must be totally wiped out.

400270414.text: It's been a tough few days.

400270415.text: The way he's sleeping is so... alert. I'm impressed.

400270417.text: He seems to be in a deep sleep. Paimon wonders if he sleep talks?

400270418.text: Ugh... Ugh, no dad, no apples for me... I want Sticky Honey Roast and Fisherman's Toast...

400270419.text: Sticky Honey Roast... That's your favorite, isn't it, Amber?

400270420.text: Hmm, sure is! Give me a Sticky Honey Roast from Good Hunter any day!

400270421.text: I used to take Eula to Good Hunter a lot back when we first met. Before long, Sara would start cooking our usual orders as soon as she saw us coming.

400270422.text: She said we ordered the same things so often that it was practically muscle memory by that point! Haha.

400270423.text: She also said that if everyone in Mondstadt ordered like we do, her job would be so much easier. All she'd have to do is to memorize everyone's favorites...

400270425.text: Always eating together... Aw, it's nice that you two are so close.

400270426.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon always eat together, too. It's a sure sign of true friendship!

400270427.text: Two people simply sharing a meal says nothing either way about the relationship between them.

400270428.text: That depends if it's a one-off meal or a regular occurrence.

400270430.text: Aha! Paimon just noticed something! Whenever Eula doesn't want to admit to something, she raises her chin or puts her hands on her hips.

400270432.text: Ah, you've all picked up on that. Didn't know Eula's tells were so easy to spot.

400270433.text: We are done here, yes? I am free to go, am I not?

400270434.text: Please excuse me. I have a frozen lake I need to be at.

400270435.text: You're going for an ice bath at this time of the night? W—Wait up, don't go without me!

400270436.text: I thought you wanted to get some sleep? So maybe you should stay here and rest.

400270437.text: No, I should come with you. It's late, and it's dark, and you're not good with directions like I am. Come on, let's go together.

400270438.text: An ice bath...? Whew, rather them than Paimon.

400270439.text: Zzz... so much... roast meat... zzz...

400270440.text: Oh... hey dad... I'm doing alright... I'm the leader of my own adventure team now... Zzz...

400270441.text: Wow, Bennett really is a sleep talker.

400270442.text: Okay, looks like we got some downtime now!

400270443.text: Alright you two, time to paint.

400270446.text: Have you decided what to paint?

400270447.text: Heh, like you even need to ask! It's obviously going to be Paimon.

400270449.text: Sure. But we should move elsewhere. We're likely to disturb Bennett's sleep if we stay here, so let's go outside.

400270450.text: Okie-dokie! Alright, grab your easel, paper, brushes, and paints, don't leave anything behind!

400270502.text: Allow Paimon to adopt an elegant pose for your artistic reference!

400270504.text: Hey! What's that look for? Cut the attitude and start putting your perfect Paimon down on the page! You'd better take this seriously, 'cause this is going on Paimon's wall!

400270506.text: Confidence is a good thing. Those to whom it is endowed do well to flaunt it. I'm looking forward to the finished piece.

400271202.text: Even now, I don't believe I have fully grasped the nature of the threat that Dragonspine poses.

400271203.text: But I will endeavor to keep you safe. That much you can trust in.

400271302.text: Hah. I wish I could simply respond with, "I'm fine."

400271303.text: But you are a true friend to me, so I should be honest with you.

400271304.text: Recently, certain questions have been occupying my mind... questions about the nature of life, and creation.

400271305.text: However, I feel that rushing into a discussion with you on these topics before my ideas on them are fully formulated will bring you far more confusion than clarity.

400271306.text: So I will wait till my thoughts are clear in my own head before I share them with you. Until then, please forgive me.

400271402.text: Don't worry about it. A chance like this to gather around the fire and chat into the night is a rare and precious one for me.

400271403.text: I won't participate in the conversation much. It's just a habit of mine.

400271404.text: But please know that I am enjoying the atmosphere all the same.

400271405.text: Of course, I'm happy to continue chatting with you if you'd like.

400271602.text: This is my camp, but let's not get bogged down in technicalities. I want you to be able to relax and make yourself at home here.

400271703.text: Bennett is sleeping soundly with his eyes tightly shut...

400271705.text: Huh... Hey! Paimon, no, don't touch that!

400271707.text: Don't touch that mechanism! Or you'll... fall down... ugh, oh well, never mind...

400271709.text: Ahhhh! What the heck is this guy dreaming about!

400270701.text: It's so nice and warm here...

400270703.text: Joel's been doing pretty good. Having people to play with has put him in a good mood.

400270704.text: I'll tell you what though, he seems to have even more stamina than me!

400270705.text: So long as they're playing, kids always seem to have endless amounts of energy.

400270901.text: This is quite cozy... for Dragonspine, I'm pleasantly surprised.

400270903.text: I gave it a try, and I actually quite enjoyed it.

400270905.text: But Amber said the snowman I made was too artistic... apparently, the conventional style is more rotund in appearance.

400270906.text: I couldn't tell if she was complimenting me or mocking me. Either way, I'm not about to let it go.

400271001.text: Pace yourself, dinner could be a while... I still have a few things to prepare.

400271102.text: I didn't expect you to be so interested in paint.

400271103.text: I once tried grinding Mist Flowers into powder and mixing it with white paint to replicate the sparkle of snowflakes.

400271104.text: The end result was quite satisfactory. But works that use this kind of paint need to be stored carefully.

400271105.text: If you want to try it for yourself, I can help you.

400279901.text: The time has come! Let's go meet Albedo at the camp!

400279902.text: Rocks? Ah! And what are these boars also doing here!?
